description: This file implements the MySQLi driver and recordset classes for the ADOdb database abstraction layer in PHP, providing functionalities for MySQL database connections, queries, metadata retrieval, transaction management, and sequence handling specific to MySQLi.

classes.name: ADODB_mysqli
classes.description: Manages MySQLi database connection, executing queries, transaction control, and schema metadata specific to MySQLi.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_mysqli
classes.description: Handles recordset operations for MySQLi result sets, including fetching, seeking, and metadata processing.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_array_mysqli
classes.description: Provides array-based recordset functionalities extending ADORecordSet_array with MySQLi-specific type handling.

methods.name: SetTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction isolation level for the database connection.

methods.name: setConnectionParameter
methods.description: Sets various connection parameters, including SSL options, socket, and port.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database with provided credentials and options.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent database connection.

methods.name: _nconnect
methods.description: Connects to the database while forcing a new connection, potentially closing previous connections.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Generates SQL for null value replacement using MySQL's IFNULL function.

methods.name: GetOne
methods.description: Fetches the first column of the first row from a query result.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves version and description info about the MySQL server.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a database transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits a database transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: RowLock
methods.description: Locks selected rows for update within a transaction.

methods.name: qStr
methods.description: Quotes a string for safe insertion into SQL statements.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last insert ID after an insert operation.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: List all databases excluding 'mysql'.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index information for a specified table.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Generates a date formatting SQL snippet using DATE_FORMAT.

methods.name: Concat
methods.description: Creates a concatenated SQL string for multiple arguments.

methods.name: OffsetDate
methods.description: Generates SQL to offset a date by a given number of days.

methods.name: MetaProcedures
methods.description: Retrieves stored procedures and functions info.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tables possibly filtered by schema, type, or name mask.

methods.name: metaForeignKeys
methods.description: Returns foreign key info for a table by parsing the CREATE TABLE statement.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Returns detailed info about columns of a table.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Selects a database to use for subsequent operations.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with limit and offset.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement; not fully implemented for bound parameters.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a given SQL with optional bound parameters, handling prepared statements.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns last error message from MySQLi connection.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns last error number from MySQLi connection.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the database connection.

methods.name: CharMax
methods.description: Maximum length for character fields.

methods.name: TextMax
methods.description: Maximum length for text fields.

methods.name: getCharSet
methods.description: Retrieves the current character set of the connection.

methods.name: setCharSet
methods.description: Sets the character set for the connection.
